# Test Constitution (Single-App Fixture)

## Core Principles

### I. Backward Compatibility (NON-NEGOTIABLE)

Existing workflows must continue to work without changes.

### II. Explicit Over Implied (NON-NEGOTIABLE)

Scope must be declared explicitly.

### III. Ownership Boundary (NON-NEGOTIABLE)

`.devspark/` is framework-owned. `.documentation/` is repo-owned.

## Additional Constraints

- Python 3.11+ for CLI code
- Markdown linted via markdownlint-cli2
